items.title: Olivia Rodrigo Plays Brooklyn’s Warsaw, Joins Bandcamp
items.summary: Olivia Rodrigo is really taking this indie rock shit seriously. It's not enough to perform with basically every remaining '90s alt-rock legend, including, just last weekend, the Smashing Pumpkins. It's not enough to continually namecheck the Cure, to the point that she's got a Robert Smith duet on her excellent new album you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love.

items.title: Defcee & Steel Tipped Dove Release Tough New Album We Will Be Brief
items.summary: Defcee is a veteran Chicago underground rapper who holds down a day job as a teacher. Steel Tipped Dove is a New York producer with many years in the game; he and backpack legend doseone released the collaborative album All Portrait, No Chorus last year. Both Defcee and Steel Tipped Dove are staples of the scene surrounding billy woods' Backwoodz label, so it's only right that the two of them have joined forces for a truly impressive new album.
